treatment_preperiod.rationale: Every maintenance repair must predate both locked Skill revisions so the public record cannot have been produced in response to either treatment.

github_api.authentication: required research credential with read-only public-metadata scope

sharding.algorithm: bisect closed adjacent nonoverlapping whole-UTC-day ranges until every terminal shard reports at most 900 results

acquisition_repetition.required_cross_acquisition_check: exact per-query terminal-shard boundaries, counts, and ordered identity digests

failure_conditions: a shard reports more than 900 results
a required page or mandatory response header is absent; ETag is recorded as explicit null when GitHub omits it
a page is fetched after the frozen cutoff without a matching immutable receipt
GitHub returns an error, abuse limit, or rate-limit response that cannot be resumed within the bounded pacing policy
the exact per-query terminal-shard boundaries, counts, or ordered identity digests differ across two server-time-separated acquisitions at least 3600 seconds apart

union_and_screening.canonical_record_key: lower-case canonical repository URL plus pull-request number
union_and_screening.query_overlap_policy: retain every query and page receipt, then deduplicate records without changing inclusion probability metadata
screening_order: fetch immutable repository, pull-request, commit, tree, file, archive, package, lock, and license evidence
freeze included and excluded records with reason codes before external randomness is requested
prohibited: dropping a candidate without an exclusion receipt
adding terms after viewing treatment outputs
counting multiple query hits for one PR as independent records

claim_boundary: The resulting frame represents only test-qualified public TypeScript Next.js merged repairs discoverable through these frozen atomic queries in the treatment-preperiod. It does not represent every React or Next.js repository, issue, or maintenance task.
